solution_summary: Bartek is the world’s largest producer of malic and fumaric acid—two key ingredients for many foods, beverages, and industrial applications. With demand increasing, the company sought to expand to reliably meet the needs of the well-known brands and customers who depend on its product. Bartek needed a technology solution that would transform business operations, maximize sales productivity, and automate business processes. The company worked with Microsoft to implement Dynamics 365 Business Central and Power Apps to unify back- and front-end operations. Based in North America and distributing to customers in more than 40 countries around the globe, Bartek is the world’s largest producer of malic acid and food-grade fumaric acid—another flavor-enhancing ingredient used in foods and beverages, with medicinal and industrial applications as well.
